en_title: Magic's Next Secret Lair Commander Deck Is The Long-Rumored Hatsune Miku Collab
subtitle: 24小时抢购窗口
opus_summary: 威世智宣布Secret Lair Commander Deck: Hatsune Miku，含100张牌、全新插画与24小时预购窗口，旨在降低黄牛抢购影响。

quality_review.review_notes: Independent bilingual self-review completed for coverage, attribution, uncertainty, numbers, dates, currency, units, names, media, and natural Chinese news style.

paragraphs.en: Magic: The Gathering is already preparing for a return trip to Middle-Earth and a detour to the Final Frontier , but the next Secret Lair Commander deck has been revealed - and it couldn’t be further from either.
paragraphs.cn: 《万智牌》已在准备重返Middle-Earth并绕道Final Frontier，但下一款Secret Lair指挥官套牌已经揭晓——它与这两者相去甚远。

paragraphs.en: Secret Lair Commander Deck: Hatsune Miku is a new ready-to-play 100-card Commander precon celebrating the iconic virtual vocalist and packed with fresh cards in a Green-White color identity.
paragraphs.cn: Secret Lair Commander Deck: Hatsune Miku是一款全新的100张牌、开盒即可游玩的指挥官预组套牌，庆祝这位标志性的虚拟歌手，并采用绿白双色身份。

paragraphs.en: Rumors had been swirling about a new Hatsune Miku Secret Lair drop, especially since we’ve had a few of them before , but this Commander deck includes 12 Foil borderless cards with new artwork, 7 Plains and 7 Forests in Foil with full-art treatments, and 74 non-foil reprints.
paragraphs.cn: 关于新的Hatsune Miku Secret Lair发售的传闻早已甚嚣尘上，尤其是此前已经推出过几次相关产品；但这款指挥官套牌包含12张箔闪无边框卡、7张带全图处理的箔闪平原和7张箔闪森林，以及74张非箔闪重印牌。

paragraphs.en: That’s alongside 10 non-foil double-sided tokens and a display Commander card for Trostani, Selensya’s Voice, as well as a deck box.
paragraphs.cn: 此外还有10个非箔闪双面指示物、Trostani, Selensya’s Voice的展示用指挥官卡，以及一个牌盒。

paragraphs.en: “Secret Lair Commander Deck: Hatsune Miku captures the bright, expressive, and collaborative spirit that has made Hatsune Miku a global phenomenon,” a press release explains, and confirms there will be artwork included from KEI, 八三/HASSAN, and さいとうなおき/NAOKI SAITO.
paragraphs.cn: 新闻稿解释称：「Secret Lair Commander Deck: Hatsune Miku捕捉了令Hatsune Miku成为全球现象的明亮、富有表现力且重视合作的精神。」新闻稿还确认，卡面插画将由KEI、八三/HASSAN和さいとうなおき/NAOKI SAITO创作。

paragraphs.en: Cards include Archangel of Thune, Aetherflux Reservoir, Voice of the Blessed, and more, but perhaps the thing hitting the right note here is the purchasing process (or at least we hope it will).
paragraphs.cn: 牌组包含Archangel of Thune、Aetherflux Reservoir、Voice of the Blessed等卡牌，但这里真正合拍的亮点或许是购买流程（至少我们希望如此）。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year, Magic’s Goblin Storm Commander Deck was swallowed up by scalpers within minutes of launch, leaving collectors feeling hard done by while they queued for the deck and saw eBay listings skyrocketing at the same time.
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，Magic's Goblin Storm Commander Deck在发售几分钟内就被黄牛抢购一空；收藏者排队购买套牌的同时，还看到eBay上的商品列表价格飙升，因此深感不满。

paragraphs.en: This time around, Secret Lair is introducing a 24-hour window to help players get their hands on the product. “Orders placed between Monday, August 10, 2026, at 9 a.m. PT and Tuesday, August 11, 2026, at 8:59 a.m. PT will be fulfilled,” the press release explains, with some shipping straight away and others slated for May 2027 in North America and June 2027 for EU/UK.
paragraphs.cn: 这一次，Secret Lair引入24小时窗口，帮助玩家买到产品。新闻稿解释称：「2026年8月10日（周一）太平洋时间上午9点至8月11日（周二）太平洋时间上午8点59分下单的订单都会得到履行。」其中一些会立即发货，其他订单则计划于2027年5月在北美、2027年6月在欧盟/英国发货。

paragraphs.en: Secret Lair Commander Deck: Hatsune Miku will be available exclusively through the Secret Lair storefront beginning August 10 at 9 a.m. PT for $149.99
paragraphs.cn: Secret Lair Commander Deck: Hatsune Miku将于8月10日太平洋时间上午9点起，在Secret Lair商店独家发售，售价149.99美元(约合人民币1014元)。
